speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: asked the Minister for National Development whether the Ministry will consider providing more incentives, including partial funding, for shopping malls to install tactile paving to aid the visually impaired.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: More information on the AF, including how to apply for funding, is available on BCA’s website.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: BCA will continue to reach out to building owners to raise awareness of the AF.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: This feedback actually came from a visually-impaired person who came to a dialogue session.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: He was sharing how at the Yishun Integrated Transport Hub, it really is very good.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: If you close your eyes, you can walk there, following the tactile paving.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: But his question was, it is very hard for him to get to there, to use the tactile paving because at the Northpoint City, there is no tactile paving.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: I understand we are encouraging the building owners to provide these for the visually-impaired but I am just wondering whether we can perhaps make it compulsory so that the visually-impaired can find it easier to get around.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: I know Northpoint City is probably an older building.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: There are certain limitations with buildings that did not come with such designs.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: When buildings are being designed, we understand the newer ones, like the Member mentioned, are better equipped to provide such tactile pavings.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: For the older ones, to be fair to building owners, we will encourage them as they undergo A&A.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: They can still tap on to the Fund.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: The Fund is quite substantive – 60% and up to $300,000.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: It is not a small sum either, to encourage more building owners to come on board.
